base_subject: Research #216: quantum-structural donor transfer and minimum-sufficient non-neural cognition (#218)

authority_constraints.study_only: no src/ change; #69 untouched; protected evaluation untouched
authority_constraints.terminals: issue #214 section 7 vocabulary only; no TRANSFORMER_REPLACED / LLM_EQUIVALENT / GENERAL_SUPERIORITY tokens; the blackboard is not claimed novel

world.ground_truth: production ocm.kso.navigation.gated_closure at stream state, external judge, never charged to arms
world.reuse_note: same production generator and scale as the #216 MSC world (research/quantum-structural-ocm-v1/msc); own salts; no benchmark authored for this study

stream.target_polarity: balanced SUPPORTED / NOT at the stream state where the serve runs
stream.revocation_selection: salt-chosen evidence whose removal flips at least one liveness
stream.drift: after serve 23 (midstream): one salt-chosen edge retracted AND one salt-chosen atom warrant replaced by certified-zero

metrics_vocabulary.decisions_exact: serves answered exactly like the oracle, of 48
metrics_vocabulary.interference_events: wrong answers whose derivation consulted an object resident in the other obligation's working set
metrics_vocabulary.stale_revocation_decisions: wrong answers following an evidence revocation (stale liveness used)
metrics_vocabulary.merge_failures: wrong answers following an admission or the catalogue drift (stale structure used)
metrics_vocabulary.drift_ops: operations consumed applying the catalogue drift
metrics_vocabulary.persistent_bytes: canonical JSON bytes of persistent state at close
metrics_vocabulary.locality_in_cone_fraction: mean fraction of update-touched objects inside the production impact_cone of the change

sufficiency.SUFFICIENT: decisions_exact == 48 AND interference_events == 0 AND stale_revocation_decisions == 0 AND merge_failures == 0
overall_terminal_rule: >=1 parent arm SUFFICIENT and cost <= 2.0 * cost(P0) -> PARENT_SUFFICIENT_FOR_working_state (parents named)
else P0 SUFFICIENT -> NON_NEURAL_FUNCTIONAL_RECONSTRUCTION_SUPPORTED_working_state (reconstruction pre-exists on main; study measures parity)
sufficiency.per_arm_cost_rule: SUFFICIENT arm with cost > 10.0 * cost(P0) additionally marked STATE_SEARCH_COST_DOMINATES

pre_registered_levers.L1_blackboard_versioning: P1A -> P1B: attribute failure to absent dependency records; add BB1-style version tags + validate-on-read recompute, charged
pre_registered_levers.L2_actr_retrieval_revalidation: P3 -> P3R: attribute failure to declarative memory having no revocation semantics; retrieval-time validity check against the current revoked set, charged
pre_registered_levers.L3_unused_reserved: buffer capacity is definitional to ACT-R and is NOT a lever; outcomes are never tuned

engineering_chain_policy: Base pass results frozen by this file, never edited after the first scored run. Negative OCM-mechanism results are engineered iteratively (attribute one stage -> apply a pre-registered lever -> re-run the SAME frozen stream -> record under results.engineering_chain with lever commit sha256) until positive or a structural obstruction proof plus the adjacent scoped positive. PARENT_SUFFICIENT is a success terminal. Outcomes, population, stream, salts and thresholds are never tuned.
mandatory_harness_validation: static-world no-alarm: update-free stream, every arm 48/48 exact, zero checker events
instrumented incumbent closure == production gated_closure on the scored population, else CANNOT_CHECK_HARNESS_DISAGREES
P2_MUTANT_NO_GOAL_BINDING detected on the scored stream, else recorded MUTANT_NOT_EXPRESSED_ON_STREAM and detector teeth proven by the forced-crosstalk test fixture only
